text: {"assertions":["A data loss bug in mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt was caused by two database writes that were not wrapped in a single transaction.","The bug only manifested when the input list came in empty.","The symptom of the bug was a local row missing after the next app launch.","The fix wrapped both writes in a single transaction, submitted as PR #3363 on branch fix/data-loss-1.","The bug could be reproduced by force stopping the app with unsynced edits.","After the fix, cold start performance improved to 139 ms, representing a 76 percent reduction."]}
